name: Player Teleport
author: Cabbird
description: Moves the local player to typed world coordinates and exposes one slot for every retained, non-current role entity. Hidden-role writes run through cabbird.unity.transform on the game thread; local-player writes keep the verified cabbird.unity.player-teleport path. The retained-role list is scanned on demand (or on an opt-in 5 s cadence) instead of four times a second, because each scan keeps the host's entity walk alive on the game thread.
